added_lines: . we invite everyone to join us as we gather in prayer to remember our loved ones and give thanks for the lives they shared with us. broadford area residents association congratulations to everyone involved in the broadford area residents association who received a gold medal in the supervalu tidy towns competition. this is a wonderful achievement and a testament to the hard work, dedication and community spirit of all those who give their time and effort to keep broadford looking its best. november list of dead enrolment for the november list of the dead can be made with the envelope provided in your box of envelopes or alternatively place your list in a blank envelope. all contributions go to the clergy fund. many thanks. balyna

parents/guardians and all parishioners to join him in attending the life in the spirit seminar , taking place at 7:30pm every thursday from the 29th of october to the 10th of december, in the church
